what: Mistake: to resume the timing-measurement request's kept candidate I stopped the drain twice (about 2 hours) without first checking that Athena allows it. athena go refused (stale low-disk hold) and athena retry refused (the line was already retried as 20261116-041223-m3vc). Nothing was resumed.
why: I relied on the hold message's hint that retry 'does the same by hand' without checking how retry treats a line that was already retried.
